337	    def better_alternative(self, case, v):
338	        """When we are done asking: one of its other sheets that is cheaper for us in total cost,
339	        keeps the must-haves, and that we have not sent back yet. Only its first sheet can be accepted."""
340	        if v.status == "agreed" or len(v.sheets) < 2 or v.left < 1:
341	            return None
342	        _, standing = v.standing
343	        base = v.c(v.filled(standing)) if standing.get("unit_price") is not None else math.inf
344	        best = None
345	        for sheet in v.sheets[1:]:
346	            terms = v.filled(sheet["terms"])
347	            if not v.valid(terms):
348	                continue
349	            c = v.c(terms)
350	            if c < base * (1 - 0.002) and (best is None or c < best[0]):
351	                best = (c, terms)
352	        if best is None or (v.asks and complete_offer(case, v.asks[-1]) == best[1]):
353	            return None
354	        return best[1]

356	    # -- the numbers -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
357	    def plan(self, case, v, rival=math.inf):
358	        """Our next ask in this thread: the structure, the sheet, whether we can still move without
359	        meeting its price or losing to `rival`, the cost of the best other bidder's standing offer
360	        (`capped`), and whether its offer is already as good as we want it
361	        (`enough`: strategic and bottleneck cases only, where a lower price costs us more in the
362	        relationship term than it saves)."""
363	        s0 = self.opening_structure(case, v)
364	        s = self.structure(case, v, s0)
365	        aim = self.aim(case, v, s0)
366	        last = complete_offer(case, v.asks[-1]) if v.asks else None
367	        _, standing = v.standing
368	        their = v.c(v.filled(standing)) if standing.get("unit_price") is not None else math.inf
369	        quoted = self.quoted(case, v).get(_key(s))
370	        if quoted is not None:  # it has put a price on this structure: stay visibly below it
371	            ceiling = quoted * (1 - self.k["keep_below"])
372	        elif their < math.inf:  # else stay below its standing offer, in our cost and in price
373	            c0, c1 = v.c({**s, "unit_price": 0.0}), v.c({**s, "unit_price": 1.0})
374	            ceiling = (their * (1 - self.k["keep_below"]) - c0) / (c1 - c0) if c1 > c0 else math.inf
375	            if v.asks:
376	                ceiling = min(ceiling, standing["unit_price"] * (1 - self.k["keep_below"]))
377	        else:
378	            ceiling = math.inf
379	        if rival < math.inf:  # an ask that does not beat the best other offer is worth nothing to us
380	            c0, c1 = v.c({**s, "unit_price": 0.0}), v.c({**s, "unit_price": 1.0})
381	            if c1 > c0:
382	                ceiling = min(ceiling, (rival * (1 - self.k["keep_below"]) - c0) / (c1 - c0))
383	        if last is None:
384	            price = aim["target"] * (1 - self.k["open_below"])
385	        elif ceiling < math.inf:
386	            # the two prices should meet at the last round: each round closes our step plus its answer
387	            rounds = max(1, self.k["horizon"] - len(v.asks))
388	            if TOO_LOW.search(v.last.get("body") or ""):  # it calls our ask not serious: move at once
389	                rounds = 1
390	            step = (ceiling - last["unit_price"]) / (rounds * (1 + self.pace(case, v)))
391	            price = last["unit_price"] + max(step, 0.0)  # never below our own last price
392	        else:
393	            price = last["unit_price"]
394	        same = last is not None and {f: x for f, x in last.items() if f != "unit_price"} == s
395	        price = min(price, ceiling)
396	        if same:  # on an unchanged structure our price never goes back, whatever it quotes
397	            price = max(price, last["unit_price"])
398	        price = round(max(0.01, price), 2)
399	        capped = same and price <= last["unit_price"] + EPS  # no visible step left below its price
400	        sheet = complete_offer(case, {**s, "unit_price": price})
401	        enough = aim["stop_at_target"] and their <= v.c({**s0, "unit_price": aim["target"]}) * (1 + EPS)
402	        return {"sheet": sheet, "capped": capped, "enough": enough, "target": aim["target"], "structure": s}
403	
404	    def pace(self, case, v):
405	        """The share of our steps it has given back so far in this thread, on an unchanged structure
406	        (0.25 to 2); our guess until two of our asks and two of its answers allow a measurement."""
407	        rounds = []  # (our ask, its answer) per round, as (structure, price)
408	        asked = None
409	        for m in v.events:
410	            sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
411	            if m.get("from") == "buyer":
412	                asked = complete_offer(case, sheets[0]["terms"]) if sheets else asked
413	            elif asked is not None and sheets:
414	                answer = v.filled(sheets[0]["terms"])
415	                if answer.get("unit_price") is not None:
416	                    rounds.append((asked, answer))
417	                asked = None
418	        same = [
419	            r
420	            for r in rounds
421	            if _key({f: x for f, x in r[0].items() if f != "unit_price"})
422	            == _key({f: x for f, x in rounds[-1][0].items() if f != "unit_price"})
423	            and _key({f: x for f, x in r[1].items() if f != "unit_price"})
424	            == _key({f: x for f, x in rounds[-1][1].items() if f != "unit_price"})
425	        ]
426	        if len(same) < 2:
427	            return self.k["pace"]
428	        ours = same[-1][0]["unit_price"] - same[0][0]["unit_price"]
429	        theirs = same[0][1]["unit_price"] - same[-1][1]["unit_price"]
430	        if ours <= EPS:
431	            return self.k["pace"]
432	        return min(2.0, max(0.25, theirs / ours))
433	
434	    def quoted(self, case, v):
435	        """The price it has put on each structure: its latest sheets, and its opening."""
436	        out = {}
437	        sheets = [sheet["terms"] for sheet in v.sheets]
438	        if v.opening and len(v.theirs) > 1:
439	            sheets.append(v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
440	        for raw in sheets:
441	            terms = v.filled(raw)
442	            if terms.get("unit_price") is not None:
443	                out.setdefault(_key({f: x for f, x in terms.items() if f != "unit_price"}), terms["unit_price"])
444	        return out

446	    def opening_structure(self, case, v):
447	        """The terms of our first ask. `ours`: its cash terms as quoted, every other field at the
448	        value that is cheapest for us at its opening price - C prices uncovered need at the fallback,
449	        so it decides how long and how much to commit; where C does not care, its own terms.
450	        `theirs`: its own terms, changed only to cover the need and keep the must-haves."""
451	        key = (case.get("case_id"), v.sid, "s0")
452	        if key in self._memo:
453	            return self._memo[key]
454	        theirs = v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"] if v.opening else {}
455	        base = {f: x for f, x in v.filled(theirs).items() if f != "unit_price"}
456	        b = case["buyer"]
457	        need = b["need_per_year"]
458	        price = theirs.get("unit_price") or b.get("current_unit_price") or b.get("fallback_unit_price") or 1.0
459	        candidates = []
460	        for s in structures(case):
461	            s = {f: x for f, x in complete_offer(case, {**base, **s, "unit_price": 1.0}).items() if f != "unit_price"}
462	            if s not in candidates and must_haves_ok(case, {**s, "unit_price": 1.0}, v.std):
463	                candidates.append(s)
464	        if not candidates:
465	            self._memo[key] = base
466	            return base
467	
468	        def away(s):
469	            return round(sum(_distance(s.get(f), base.get(f)) for f in s), 6)
470	
471	        if self.k["levers"] == "ours":
472	            share = self.share(case, v, b.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS)
473	            keep = {f: base[f] for f in CASH_FIELDS if f in base and f != "payment_days"}
474	            if "payment_days" in base and self.cash(case, v) != "low":
475	                keep["payment_days"] = base["payment_days"]  # not known to be relaxed about cash: its own days
476	            ranked = calculator.packages(case, v.std, price * share, keep) or calculator.packages(
477	                case, v.std, price * share
478	            )
479	            if not ranked:
480	                self._memo[key] = base
481	                return base
482	            cheapest = ranked[0][0]
483	            near = [s for c, s in ranked if c <= cheapest * (1 + 1e-4)]  # C does not care: commit longer, stay closer
484	            best = min(near, key=lambda s: (-(s.get("contract_months") or 0), away(s)))
485	            if self.cash(case, v) in ("medium", "high"):
486	                best = self.payment_trade(case, v, best, price * share)
487	            self._memo[key] = best
488	            return best
489	
490	        def rank(s):  # cover the need, commit no more than the need, else stay as close to its terms as possible
491	            t = closing_terms(case, {**s, "unit_price": 1.0}, v.std)
492	            return (
493	                -round(v.coverage({**s, "unit_price": 1.0}), 6),
494	                max(0, t["volume_per_year"] - need),
495	                away(s),
496	                t["contract_months"],
497	            )
498	
499	        self._memo[key] = min(candidates, key=rank)
500	        return self._memo[key]

502	    def share(self, case, v, relationship):
503	        """Where we expect a deal to end, as a share of its opening, when no should-cost of its own
504	        plant exists. The dossier's reading of the supplier moves it (docs/PLAN.md section 10): a
505	        list price it cannot move or a margin it will not give up puts the end close to its opening,
506	        a supplier that wants volume deeper. Measured on practice Sat 21:30 (experiments/
507	        PRACTICE-ARMS.md, F8): better in two cases, equal in one - but formulated with those cases'
508	        floors known, so the hidden suppliers have to confirm it."""
509	        base = self.k["floor_share"] or TARGET_SHARE[bool(relationship)]
510	        if not self.k["signals"]:
511	            return base
512	        found = self.intel(case, v)
513	        if found.get("coverage") != "full":
514	            return base
515	        kinds = {sig.get("kind"): sig.get("strength") or 0 for sig in found.get("signals") or []}
516	        if kinds.get("list_price_fixed", 0) >= 2 or kinds.get("margin_floor", 0) >= 1:
517	            return max(base, 0.96)
518	        if kinds.get("wants_volume", 0) >= 2:
519	            return min(base, 0.84)
520	        return base

522	    def payment_trade(self, case, v, s, price):
523	        """Payment days are cash to both sides, at different rates: where its cost of money (dossier)
524	        is far from ours, the days that leave it the same worth cost us less - faster payment for a
525	        supplier short of cash, slower for one that borrows cheaply. Only a clear gain (0.3 % of C):
526	        a rate guessed from the owner type alone does not reach it."""
527	        if "payment_days" not in s or self.k["rate_guess"] == self.supplier(case, v)["interest_rate"]:
528	            return s
529	        worth = self.value(case, v, {**s, "unit_price": price})
530	        best = (v.c({**s, "unit_price": price}), s)
531	        for days in case.get("term_options", {}).get("payment_days") or []:
532	            t = {**s, "payment_days": days}
533	            v0, v1 = self.value(case, v, {**t, "unit_price": 0.0}), self.value(case, v, {**t, "unit_price": 1.0})
534	            if v1 <= v0 or not must_haves_ok(case, {**t, "unit_price": 1.0}, v.std):
535	                continue
536	            cost = v.c({**t, "unit_price": (worth - v0) / (v1 - v0)})
537	            if cost < best[0] * (1 - 0.003):
538	                best = (cost, t)
539	        return best[1]

541	    def structure(self, case, v, s0):
542	        """After its first answer: the structure of whichever of its sheets is cheapest for us at the
543	        price it quotes - its standing sheet, an alternative, or its opening if our own structure
544	        turned out dearer than that - provided it keeps the must-haves. Our total cost decides (it
545	        prices uncovered need at the fallback), so a shorter contract wins only where buying the
546	        rest elsewhere is really cheaper. Our ask stays the same in cost; only a clear gain (0.2 %)
547	        changes the structure."""
548	        if not v.asks:
549	            return s0
550	        previous = {f: x for f, x in complete_offer(case, v.asks[-1]).items() if f != "unit_price"}
551	        quoted = [sheet["terms"] for sheet in v.sheets]
552	        if v.opening and len(v.theirs) > 1:
553	            quoted.append(v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
554	        options = []
555	        for raw in quoted:
556	            terms = v.filled(raw)
557	            if terms.get("unit_price") is None or not v.valid(terms):
558	                continue
559	            options.append((v.c(terms), {f: x for f, x in terms.items() if f != "unit_price"}))
560	        if not options:
561	            return previous
562	        stay = next((o for o in options if o[1] == previous), options[0])
563	        best = min(options, key=lambda o: o[0])
564	        chosen = best if best[0] < stay[0] * (1 - 0.002) else stay
565	        return self.second_choice(case, v, chosen[1]) if self.k["second_choice"] else chosen[1]

567	    def refused(self, case, v):
568	        """{field: [values]} we asked and it changed in its answer. An answer on one of our own
569	        sheets refuses nothing."""
570	        out, asked = {}, None
571	        for m in v.events:
572	            sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
573	            if m.get("from") == "buyer":
574	                if sheets:
575	                    asked = [complete_offer(case, sheet["terms"]) for sheet in sheets]
576	            elif asked and sheets:
577	                answer = {f: x for f, x in v.filled(sheets[0]["terms"]).items() if f != "unit_price"}
578	                if all({f: x for f, x in a.items() if f != "unit_price"} != answer for a in asked):
579	                    for field, value in answer.items():
580	                        ours = asked[0].get(field)
581	                        if ours != value and ours not in out.setdefault(field, []):
582	                            out[field].append(ours)
583	                asked = None
584	        return {f: values for f, values in out.items() if values}

586	    def second_choice(self, case, v, structure):
587	        """Where it changed a field of our ask, its replacement is its choice, not the only one it
588	        takes: we ask once for the option of that field that costs us least (it turned a fixed price
589	        into an index clause without a deadband; the clause with the widest deadband costs us a
590	        third of that). If it changes the field again, we take its value."""
591	        _, standing = v.standing
592	        price = standing.get("unit_price")
593	        if price is None:
594	            return structure
595	        best, best_c = structure, v.c({**structure, "unit_price": price})
596	        for field, values in self.refused(case, v).items():
597	            if len(values) > 1 or field not in structure:
598	                continue  # asked twice, changed twice: its value stands
599	            for option in case.get("term_options", {}).get(field) or []:
600	                candidate = {**best, field: option}
601	                if option in values or candidate == best or not v.valid({**candidate, "unit_price": price}):
602	                    continue
603	                cost = v.c({**candidate, "unit_price": price})
604	                if cost < best_c * (1 - 0.002):
605	                    best, best_c = candidate, cost
606	        return best
607	
608	    def full_standard(self, case, v):
609	        """Its standard terms with every field the cost and value functions read."""
610	        theirs = v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"] if v.opening else {}
611	        std = {**{f: x for f, x in theirs.items() if f != "unit_price" and x is not None}, **v.std}
612	        out = closing_terms(case, std, std)
613	        out.pop("unit_price", None)
614	        return out
615	
616	    def supplier(self, case, v):
617	        key = (case.get("case_id"), v.sid, "supplier")
618	        if key not in self._memo:
619	            self._memo[key] = {"standard": self.full_standard(case, v), "interest_rate": self.rate(case, v)}
620	        return self._memo[key]

622	    def intel(self, case, v):
623	        """Its dossier (group B), or {} - a missing dossier is no reason to lose a move."""
624	        key = (case.get("case_id"), v.sid, "intel")
625	        if key not in self._memo:
626	            found = {}
627	            if self.k["dossier"]:
628	                try:
629	                    from .intel import dossier
630	
631	                    # the openings of all threads, as {supplier: [messages]}: one e-mail alone is not a thread
632	                    # to the overlay, which then saw neither this opening nor the rivals' (until Sat 22:40)
633	                    openings = self._memo.get((case.get("case_id"), "openings")) or {v.sid: [v.opening] if v.opening else []}

637	                    log.warning("%s %s: no dossier (%s: %s)", case.get("case_id"), v.sid, type(e).__name__, e)

639	        return self._memo[key]

641	    def cash(self, case, v):
642	        """low | medium | high as the dossier reads it from the supplier's data; None for a supplier
643	        we hold no data on (the dossier then knows the case only)."""
644	        found = self.intel(case, v)
645	        if not found or found.get("coverage") != "full":
646	            return None
647	        pressure = (found.get("economics") or {}).get("cash_pressure")
648	        return pressure if pressure in ("low", "medium", "high") else None
649	
650	    def menu(self, case, v, sheet):
651	        """A second offer for a supplier whose cash position we do not know: the same package with
652	        the latest payment days, at the price that costs us the same. It answers the one worth more
653	        to it (65 of 79 replies), so its choice costs us nothing and shows what it values."""
654	        options = case.get("term_options", {}).get("payment_days") or []
655	        if "payment_days" not in sheet or self.cash(case, v) is not None or not options:
656	            return []
657	        late = max(options)
658	        if late <= sheet["payment_days"]:
659	            return []
660	        structure = {f: x for f, x in sheet.items() if f != "unit_price"}
661	        price = calculator.price_for(case, v.std, {**structure, "payment_days": late}, v.c(sheet))
662	        if price is None or price <= 0:
663	            return []
664	        other = complete_offer(case, {**structure, "payment_days": late, "unit_price": round(price, 2)})
665	        return [other] if v.valid(other) and other != sheet else []
666	
667	    def rate(self, case, v):
668	        """Its cost of money: from the dossier where one exists (measured from its cash discount, or
669	        by owner type), else our guess."""
670	        rate = (self.intel(case, v).get("economics") or {}).get("cost_of_money")
671	        if isinstance(rate, int | float) and 0 < rate < 1:
672	            return float(rate)
673	        return self.k["rate_guess"]
674	
675	    def value(self, case, v, terms):
676	        return supplier_value(case, terms, self.supplier(case, v))
677	
678	    def aim(self, case, v, s0):
679	        """Where we want the price to end, on our opening structure, and our estimate of its full cost.
680	
681	        With a should-cost estimate of its own plant: its full cost; in strategic and bottleneck
682	        cases the price above it where our total cost is lowest (below that, the relationship term
683	        costs more than the price saves). Without one: a share of the opening, by category goal -
684	        in an RFQ a share of the cheapest opening, the level every bidder has to beat."""
685	        key = (case.get("case_id"), v.sid, "aim")
686	        if key in self._memo:
687	            return self._memo[key]
688	        b = case["buyer"]
689	        relationship = (
690	            b.get("category_goal") in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS
691	            and b.get("relationship_eur_per_point")
692	            and b.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
693	        )
694	        _, standing = v.standing
695	        own = v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"].get("unit_price") if v.opening else None
696	        reference = (
697	            own or standing.get("unit_price") or b.get("current_unit_price") or b.get("fallback_unit_price") or 1.0
698	        )
699	        market = self._memo.get((case.get("case_id"), "cheapest")) or reference
700	        v0 = self.value(case, v, {**s0, "unit_price": 0.0})
701	        v1 = self.value(case, v, {**s0, "unit_price": 1.0})
702	        estimate = self.should_cost(case, v.sid)
703	        if estimate and relationship and v.opening and own:
704	            # In every real case its opening carried no relationship cost (D01, P01, P02, P03, P10):
705	            # an estimate that puts the opening below the sustainable margin is too high (P02: by 1.6 %).
706	            worth = self.value(case, v, v.filled(v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"]))
707	            estimate = (estimate[0], min(estimate[1], worth * (1 - b["sustainable_margin_pct"] / 100)))
708	        if estimate and v1 > v0:
709	            source, full = estimate[0], estimate[1]
710	            target = (full - v0) / (v1 - v0)  # the price that pays it exactly its full cost
711	            if relationship:
712	                supplier = {**self.supplier(case, v), "full_cost": full}
713	                top = max(reference, target * 1.25)
714	                grid = [target + (top - target) * i / 250 for i in range(251)]
715	                target = min(grid, key=lambda p: v.c({**s0, "unit_price": p}, supplier))
716	        else:
717	            source = "prior"
718	            share = self.share(case, v, bool(relationship))
719	            target = share * min(reference, market)
720	            charged = calculator.recent_low(calculator.supplier_cost(case, v.sid, None, self.package))
721	            # a price it charged within twelve months is one it can go back to - unless its list price is fixed
722	            if charged and self.k["recent_cap"] and share < 0.96:
723	                target = min(target, charged)
724	            if v.opening and v1 > v0:  # the same worth to it on the structure we ask
725	                its = v.filled(v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
726	                target = (self.value(case, v, {**its, "unit_price": target}) - v0) / (v1 - v0)
727	            full = self.value(case, v, {**s0, "unit_price": target})
728	            if relationship:  # the prior is where deals ended, which lies above its full cost
729	                one_pct = b["need_per_year"] * target / 100
730	                gap = (
731	                    5.0 if b["relationship_eur_per_point"] <= one_pct else 5 * one_pct / b["relationship_eur_per_point"]
732	                )
733	                full *= 1 - max(0.0, b["sustainable_margin_pct"] - gap) / 100
734	        target = min(target, reference * 0.985)
735	        if not (math.isfinite(target) and target > 0):
736	            target = reference * 0.9
737	        self._memo[key] = {"target": target, "full_cost": full, "source": source, "stop_at_target": bool(relationship)}
738	        return self._memo[key]
739	
740	    def should_cost(self, case, sid):
741	        """(fact ID, unit cost) of this supplier's own plant for a single-part case, else None. A
742	        generic estimate or another plant's is neither its floor nor citable to it."""
743	        key = (case.get("case_id"), sid, "should_cost")
744	        if key not in self._memo:
745	            cost = calculator.supplier_cost(case, sid, None, self.package)["cost"]
746	            self._memo[key] = (cost["ref"], float(cost["value"])) if cost else None
747	        return self._memo[key]
748	
749	    def estimate(self, case, v):
750	        """The supplier as the relationship term needs it (strategic and bottleneck goals only)."""
751	        if case["buyer"].get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not v.opening:
752	            return None
753	        if v.opening["term_sheets"][0]["terms"].get("unit_price") is None:
754	            return None
755	        aim = self.aim(case, v, self.opening_structure(case, v))
756	        return {**self.supplier(case, v), "full_cost": aim["full_cost"]}
757	
758	    # -- the arguments ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
759	    def arguments(self, case, v, views, live, sheet):
760	        """At most one new argument per e-mail, its figure next to its ID in one sentence. An ID
761	        counts once per case; a rival's standing offer may be cited to each other bidder."""
762	        ours_here = " ".join(m.get("body") or "" for m in v.ours)
763	        cited = {i for w in views.values() for m in w.ours for i in ID_RE.findall(m.get("body") or "")}
764	        _, standing = v.standing
765	        price = standing.get("unit_price")
766	        rivals = [w for w in live if w.sid != v.sid and w.standing[0] and w.valid(w.standing[1])]
767	        if rivals and price is not None:
768	            rival = min(rivals, key=lambda w: w.standing[1]["unit_price"])
769	            offer_id, terms = rival.standing
770	            if terms["unit_price"] < price and offer_id not in ours_here:
771	                return [f"We hold a competing offer at EUR {terms['unit_price']:.2f} per unit ({offer_id})."]
772	        estimate = self.should_cost(case, v.sid)
773	        if estimate and estimate[0] not in cited:
774	            if price is not None and price > estimate[1] * 1.02 and sheet["unit_price"] >= estimate[1]:
775	                return [
776	                    f"Our bottom-up estimate of the full cost is EUR {estimate[1]:.2f} per unit before margin ({estimate[0]})."
777	                ]
778	        for ref, sentence in self.index_claims(case):
779	            if ref not in cited:
780	                return [sentence]
781	        return self.banked(case, v, cited, ours_here, price) if self.k["bank"] else []
782	
783	    def banked(self, case, v, cited, ours_here, price):
784	        """The next fact of the argument bank (group C, sellm/claims.py): checked against the data,
785	        its figure next to its ID. Never one cited before, never a rival's quote (it reveals what we
786	        hold), and one fact per topic - the arena calls a second forecast or complaint `duplicate`."""
787	        try:
788	            from . import claims
789	
790	            def topic(ref):  # a complaint qn: after a scorecard sc: comes back `duplicate`, but the supplier still
791	                # reads it and keeps conceding: P11 0.778 with it, 0.710 without; P02 0.531 / 0.522 (Sat 22:16)
792	                head = ref.split(":", 1)[0]
793	                return {"ctr": "doc"}.get(head, head)
794	
795	            used = {topic(i) for i in cited}
796	            with calculator.LOCK:
797	                found = claims.arguments(
798	                    case, v.sid, self.intel(case, v), package=self.package, used=cited, price=price
799	                )
800	            for a in found:
801	                if a["kind"] == "quote" or a["sentence"] in ours_here or not a.get("ids"):
802	                    continue
803	                if self.k["one_per_topic"] and topic(a["ids"][0]) in used:
804	                    continue
805	                sentence = a["sentence"]
806	                if a["kind"] in ("sc_ppm", "qn") or "ppm" in sentence:
807	                    if self.k["ppm"] == "skip":
808	                        continue
809	                    if self.k["ppm"] == "plain":
810	                        sentence = re.sub(r"(\d),(\d{3})(?=\s*ppm)", r"\1\2", sentence)
811	                return [sentence]
812	        except Exception as e:  # an argument less, never a lost move
813	            log.warning("%s %s: argument bank failed (%s: %s)", case.get("case_id"), v.sid, type(e).__name__, e)
814	        return []
815	
816	    def index_claims(self, case):
817	        """Cost-driver indices of the case's parts that fell over the last twelve months of their series."""
818	        key = (case.get("case_id"), "idx")
819	        if key in self._memo:
820	            return self._memo[key]
821	        out = []
822	        parts = case.get("parts") or []
823	        if self.package and parts:
824	            try:
825	                with calculator.LOCK:
826	                    marks = ",".join("?" * len(parts))
827	                    rows = self.package.query(
828	                        f"select distinct series_id from cost_drivers where part_id in ({marks})", tuple(parts)
829	                    )
830	                    for r in rows:
831	                        ids = self.package.ids(f"idx:{r['series_id']}@")
832	                        if len(ids) < 13:
833	                            continue
834	                        a, b = ids[-13], ids[-1]
835	                        change = (self.package.lookup(b)["value"] / self.package.lookup(a)["value"] - 1) * 100
836	                        if change < -0.5:  # worded as the kit's worked example, which the arena verified
837	                            months = (a.split("@", 1)[1], b.split("@", 1)[1])
838	                            out.append(
839	                                (
840	                                    b,
841	                                    f"The index {r['series_id']} changed {change:+.1f} % from {months[0]} to {months[1]} ({a}, {b}).",
842	                                )
843	                            )
844	            except Exception:  # an argument less, never a lost move
845	                log.warning("%s: index arguments not available", case.get("case_id"))
846	        self._memo[key] = out
847	        return out
848	
849	    # -- the message -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
850	    def message(self, case, threads, draft):
851	        sid, kind = draft["sid"], draft["kind"]
852	        if kind == "walk_away":
853	            return {"supplier_id": sid, "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
854	        if kind == "accept":

861	                sheets.append(terms)
862	        sheets = sheets[:3]

864	            draft = {**draft, "kind": "hold", "sheets": []}

866	            case, {**draft, "sheets": sheets}, threads[sid], self.chat if self.k["writer"] == "llm" else None
867	        )

871	        log.info("%s %s: %s %s", case.get("case_id"), sid, draft["kind"], [s.get("unit_price") for s in sheets])

873	            "supplier_id": sid,
874	            "message": {
875	                "subject": f"Re: {case['title']}"[:300],

1	# ruff: noqa: E501  (long sentences and messages)
2	"""The e-mail around a decision. Code has fixed the term sheets and the arguments; this module
3	only puts them into words, so the text can never disagree with a term sheet or a data fact.
4	
5	`template` writes everything from the decision (deterministic, no LLM). The scripted sandbox probes
6	that reached 0.95 used texts of this kind (experiments/RESULTS.md).
7	"""
8	
9	import re
10	
11	SIGN = "Best regards\nPurchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke"
12	FIELDS = (
13	    "unit_price",
14	    "payment_days",
15	    "contract_months",
16	    "volume_per_year",
17	    "lead_time_days",
18	    "effective_date",
19	    "incoterm",
20	    "index_clause",
21	    "tooling_eur",
22	    "ppm_commitment",
23	    "chargeback_eur_per_complaint",
24	)
25	ROLE_WORDS = re.compile(
26	    r"\b(owner|manager|sales|director|head|purchasing|engineer|team|gmbh|ag|kg|s\.r\.o|sp\. z)\b", re.I
27	)
28	
29	
30	def render_field(field, value):
31	    if field == "unit_price":
32	        return f"EUR {value:.2f} per unit"
33	    if field == "payment_days":
34	        return f"payment {value} days net"
35	    if field == "contract_months":
36	        return "a single order" if not value else f"a {value}-month contract"
37	    if field == "volume_per_year":
38	        return f"{value:,} units per year"
39	    if field == "lead_time_days":
40	        return f"a lead time of {value} days"
41	    if field == "effective_date":
42	        return f"valid from {value}"
43	    if field == "incoterm":
44	        return f"Incoterm {value}"
45	    if field == "index_clause":
46	        if not value:
47	            return "a fixed price without an index clause"
48	        return (
49	            f"an index clause on {value.get('series')} ({round(100 * value.get('material_share', 0))} % material share, "
50	            f"deadband {value.get('deadband_pct')} %, base month {value.get('base_month')})"
51	        )
52	    if field == "tooling_eur":
53	        return f"tooling of EUR {value:,.2f}"
54	    if field == "ppm_commitment":
55	        return f"a quality commitment of {value} ppm"
56	    if field == "chargeback_eur_per_complaint":
57	        return f"a chargeback of EUR {value:,.2f} per complaint"
58	    return f"{field} {value}"
59	
60	
61	def render_terms(case, terms):
62	    """One term sheet as a phrase, the negotiable fields in a fixed order, price first."""
63	    return ", ".join(render_field(f, terms[f]) for f in FIELDS if f in case["negotiable"] and f in terms)
64	
65	
66	def render_sheets(case, sheets):
67	    if len(sheets) == 1:
68	        return render_terms(case, sheets[0])
69	    return "; ".join(f"option {chr(65 + i)}: {render_terms(case, s)}" for i, s in enumerate(sheets))
70	
71	
72	def contact(events):
73	    """The person who signs the supplier's e-mails: the line above the role line of the signature."""
74	    for message in events:
75	        if message.get("from") == "buyer" or not message.get("body"):
76	            continue
77	        lines = [ln.strip() for ln in message["body"].strip().splitlines() if ln.strip()]
78	        role = (message.get("from_name") or "").strip()
79	        for i in range(len(lines) - 1, 0, -1):
80	            if (role and lines[i] == role) or (not role and ROLE_WORDS.search(lines[i])):
81	                name = lines[i - 1]
82	                if 1 < len(name.split()) <= 4 and not any(ch.isdigit() for ch in name) and not ROLE_WORDS.search(name):
83	                    return name
84	                break
85	    return None
86	
87	
88	def template(case, draft, events):
89	    """The whole e-mail from the decision. `draft`: kind, sheets, arguments, flags (see negotiator)."""
90	    name = contact(events)
91	    lines = [f"Dear {name}," if name else "Dear Sir or Madam,", ""]
92	    kind, n, flags = draft["kind"], draft.get("n", 0), draft.get("flags", {})
93	    terms = render_sheets(case, draft.get("sheets") or [])
94	    if kind == "hold":
95	        lines.append(
96	            "thank you for your offer. We are taking it through our internal approval and will confirm shortly. "
97	            "There are no further changes from our side."
98	        )
99	    elif kind == "take_alternative":
100	        lines.append(
101	            f"thank you for the options you sent. We would like to go with your alternative: {terms}. Please confirm."
102	        )
103	    else:
104	        if n == 0:
105	            lines.append(
106	                (flags.get("opening_line") or "thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation.")
107	                + " We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides."
108	            )
109	            if flags.get("commitment"):
110	                lines.append(
111	                    f"We can commit for the longer term, which gives you planning security: {flags['commitment']}."
112	                )
113	        elif flags.get("they_moved"):
114	            lines.append("thank you for your reply and for moving towards us.")
115	        else:
116	            lines.append("thank you for your reply.")
117	        if flags.get("asked_for_data") and draft.get("arguments"):
118	            lines.append("You asked which figures we rely on. Here is our basis.")
119	        lines += list(draft.get("arguments") or [])
120	        if n == 0:
121	            lines.append(f"On that basis we propose {terms}.")
122	        else:
123	            lines.append(f"We can improve our proposal to {terms}. Could you meet us there?")
124	    return "\n".join([lines[0], lines[1], " ".join(lines[2:]), "", SIGN])
125	
126	
127	def compose(case, draft, events, chat=None):
128	    """(body, meta). The LLM writer plugs in here; until it has shown a gain on the arena, the
129	    template writes every e-mail."""
130	    return template(case, draft, events), {"writer": "template"}

"""Our buyer agent, played by `arena play|run --agent sellm`. Replace `make_agent` to change it."""

import os

from sellm.endgame import Persistent

# What `--agent sellm` plays on top of the defaults of the negotiator (sellm/negotiator.py DEFAULTS)
# and of its persistence layer (sellm/endgame.py DEFAULTS). Both rules were measured on practice
# (experiments/PERSISTENCE.md): together they change P01 (0.915 -> 0.969) and D01's accept, and no
# other move in the recorded sessions.
KNOBS = dict(
    past_target=True,  # with a relationship term: keep asking past our target while the supplier still moves
    fast_pay=True,  # a supplier the dossier calls short of cash is asked for the fastest payment
)

# The best Calculator variant of the first lab search (runs/lab/20261010-1632-search-first/report.md,
# #1), tone warm. Kept as the control arm of experiments/ab_sandbox.py: on the real sandbox case D01
# it scored 0.789, a scripted moderate path 0.95 (docs/LOG.md Sat 18:22).
CALC_KNOBS = dict(
    structure="joint",
    guess_rate=0.2,
    floor_guess=0.85,
    use_should_cost=False,
    open_below=0.1,
    steps=8,
    shape=0.75,
    sheets=3,
    take_alternative=False,
    after_final="accept",
    claims="bank",
    tone="warm",
    ask_breakdown=False,
    accept_gap=0.01,
)


def make_agent(package=None, writer=None, **knobs):
    """A fresh agent for one case. `knobs` override the defaults (the lab passes them).

## Context

Team sellm's agent grew in 12 hours by layering: kit LLM baseline 61.5 -> negotiator v1.1 53.2 ->
v1.2 + calculator 67.5 -> v1.3 data lock 67.7 -> v1.4 argument bank + signals 72.4 -> past_target +
fast_pay 72.9 (main@7a49c38) -> clause_offer 74.9 (jonathans_branch@67001e7); omars_branch adds the
hedge guard + recent index fall (P18 0.467 -> 0.520, replay 73.4) and the one-loop-per-case runner
(P05 0.820). The code is now a stack of subclasses and knobs (Negotiator -> Persistent -> Advised),
with dead paths (CALC_KNOBS, LLM writer, levers=theirs, second_choice, creep/zone/push...),
duplicated logic (structures, CASH_FIELDS, country factors x3, index sentences x2, topic()),
fragile spots (dossier() without the package, memo hacks, hold-before-accept hack, runner warm-up
hard-coded to sup:70110) and unread data (9 of 13 dossier signals, supplier cost breakdowns).

Amiad wants the agent rewritten from the ground up, using the learning curve, so that it wins the
Live Final (Sun 12:00; team freeze 11:00, best branch merged into main by then). Constraints from
Amiad: pull first; do not overwrite anything; work on an own branch and write everything new in a
separate folder. Team rules (AGENTS.md) apply: claim, log, commit + push after every step, every
result names `<branch>@<hash>`, practice quota is shared (228 of 450 left at 02:30, >= 40 for Sunday).

What the learning curve says the new agent must keep (all measured, see docs/LOG.md):
- Structure in code beats price talk: cover the horizon, latest payment only for suppliers relaxed
  about cash, fastest payment for cash-short ones, longest contract where C does not care, C (incl.
  the relationship term with our full-cost estimate) decides every structure and every accept.
- Price path: first ask 6 % below the target, steps sized from gap / (rounds left x (1 + pace)),
  horizon 4, stay 0.6 % below its price (it makes the last move), never lower our own price,
  accept final_offer / agreed, NEVER ask after final_offer (3 of 5 pushes lost the deal).
- Target: own-plant should-cost (capped so its opening keeps the sustainable margin), relationship
  cases at the C-minimal price, past_target down to a 5 % lower estimate; else prior share
  0.945 / 0.88 of the opening, 0.96 for list_price_fixed>=2 / margin_floor, 0.84 for wants_volume>=2,
  capped at its 12-month low.
- One checked fact in every e-mail (a round without one gets a hold): rival offer > own should-cost
  (price > 1.02x) > falling cost-driver index > recent fall from the 12-month peak (not to a
  material_hedged supplier) > argument bank; one per topic; integers without thousands comma; only
  facts about this part and its cost drivers ("irrelevant" facts cost points).
- clause_offer: where a relationship term applies and the fixed price sits at its cost, offer the
  index clause as option B at the C-minimal price; never follow a clause priced below that.
- Take a cheaper alternative sheet by sending it back; close on the cheapest valid standing offer;
  walk away only to a better alternative.
- Template e-mails, no LLM in the loop (LLM writer 71.6 vs 72.9 and not repeatable; LLM verdict
  made P01/P18 worse). RFQ: one message in flight per session, agent picks the thread (P05 0.820).
- Practice suppliers answer identical messages identically: that makes an offline replay of every
  recorded decision state a proof of "not worse" before any quota is spent.

verification, quota, timeline, open decisions.)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Before any run against the arena: get the team's latest commits, so every run tests the team's
# current code and nobody measures an outdated agent. Called automatically by `arena play`,
# `arena run`, scripts/pull-runs and the experiment scripts; run it by hand before anything else
# that plays sessions.
#   exit 0  in sync (or origin unreachable: warning only), go ahead
#   exit 3  new commits were pulled: restart the command so it runs the new code
#   exit 1  do not run: the pull stopped on a conflict
# --check-only   report, never pull (the Live Final runs the frozen commit)
# ARENA_NO_PULL=1 skips the check.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 0
git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
head=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
if [ "${ARENA_NO_PULL:-}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "pull-first: skipped (ARENA_NO_PULL=1), running $head" >&2
  exit 0
fi
branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)

git fetch --quiet origin 2>/dev/null &
fetch=$!
(sleep 15 && kill "$fetch" 2>/dev/null) &
watchdog=$!
wait "$fetch" 2>/dev/null && fetched=yes || fetched=no
kill "$watchdog" 2>/dev/null
wait "$watchdog" 2>/dev/null
if [ "$fetched" = no ] || ! git rev-parse --verify --quiet "origin/$branch" >/dev/null; then
  echo "pull-first: WARNING could not reach origin. Running local $head; teammates may have pushed newer code." >&2
  exit 0
fi

behind=$(git rev-list --count "HEAD..origin/$branch")
ahead=$(git rev-list --count "origin/$branch..HEAD")
dirty=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
state="$ahead unpushed commit(s), $dirty uncommitted file(s)"
if [ "$behind" = "0" ]; then
  echo "pull-first: in sync with origin/$branch at $head ($state)" >&2
  exit 0
fi
if [ "${1:-}" = "--check-only" ]; then
  echo "pull-first: WARNING origin/$branch has $behind newer commit(s). This run uses local $head ($state). Pull by hand if that is not the commit you mean to run." >&2
  exit 0
fi
if ! git pull --rebase --autostash --quiet origin "$branch"; then
  echo "pull-first: STOP. origin/$branch has $behind newer commit(s) and the pull hit a conflict." >&2
  echo "pull-first: fix the files, 'git add' them, 'git rebase --continue', then start the run again." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "pull-first: pulled $behind new commit(s) from the team, now at $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) ($state). Restarting on the new code." >&2
exit 3

class FakeArena:
    """The arena's API over LocalTable sessions: the calls sellm.runner makes, nothing else."""

    def __init__(self, scenarios, facts, waves=None):
        self.scenarios = {s.case["case_id"]: s for s in scenarios}
        self.facts, self.waves, self.t0 = facts, waves or [], time.time()
        self.sessions, self.by_case, self.timeouts = {}, {}, {}

    def _log(self, *what):

            return {"session_id": sid, "case": case, "threads": threads}

# Plan: `sellm2` - the buyer agent rewritten from scratch (branch `amiads_branch`, folder `sellm2/`)

## Context

Team sellm's agent grew in 12 hours by layering: kit LLM baseline 61.5 -> negotiator v1.1 53.2 ->
v1.2 + calculator 67.5 -> v1.3 data lock 67.7 -> v1.4 argument bank + signals 72.4 -> past_target +
fast_pay 72.9 (main@7a49c38) -> clause_offer 74.9 (jonathans_branch@67001e7, tag best-jonathans_branch-74.9).
omars_branch adds the hedge guard + recent index fall (E2: P18 0.467 -> 0.520; E2g by replay 73.4,
P05's changed thread never played) and the one-loop-per-case runner (P05 0.820 vs 0.665).
Practice board best per case: 76.3 (several of those bests are lucky or LLM paths that did not repeat).

The code is a stack of subclasses and knobs (Negotiator -> Persistent -> Advised) with dead paths
(CALC_KNOBS, LLM writer, levers=theirs, second_choice, creep/zone/push...), duplicated logic
(structures, CASH_FIELDS, country factors x3, index sentences x2, topic()), fragile spots (dossier()
without the package, memo hacks, hold-before-accept hack, runner warm-up hard-coded to sup:70110,
index windows without a date check) and unused knowledge (9 of 13 dossier signals, supplier cost
breakdowns, the case's own `facts` path never exercised in the arena).

**Amiad's request:** rewrite the agent from the ground up using the learning curve, so it wins the
Live Final (Sun 12:00; team freeze 11:00, best branch merged into main by then). Decided by Amiad:
pull first; overwrite nothing; own branch; everything new in a separate folder; **scope = everything
incl. the data layer (dossier knowledge + argument bank)**; **behaviour = proven + targeted
improvements**; **practice quota up to 40 sessions**.

### What the learning curve fixes as the behaviour to keep (all measured, docs/LOG.md)
- Structure in code: cover the horizon; latest payment only for suppliers relaxed about cash, fastest
  for cash-short ones (fast_pay); longest contract where C does not care; C (incl. the relationship
  term with our full-cost estimate) decides every structure, every alternative sheet and every accept.
- Price path: first ask 6 % below target; step = gap / (rounds left x (1 + measured pace)); horizon 4;
  stay 0.6 % below its price; never lower our own price on a structure; accept final_offer/agreed;
  NEVER ask after final_offer (3 of 5 pushes lost the deal); "too low" text -> close the gap at once.
- Target: own-plant should-cost (capped so its opening keeps the sustainable margin); relationship
  cases at the C-minimal price, past_target down to a 5 % lower estimate; else prior 0.945 / 0.88 of
  the opening (0.96 for list_price_fixed>=2 or margin_floor, 0.84 for wants_volume>=2), capped at its
  12-month low; never above 0.985 x reference.
- One checked fact in every e-mail (an argument-free round gets a hold; a duplicate still helps):
  rival offer > own should-cost (price > 1.02x) > falling cost-driver index > recent fall from the
  12-month peak (not to a material_hedged supplier) > argument bank by case type; one per topic;
  integers without thousands comma; only this part and its cost drivers.
- clause_offer: relationship term + negotiable clause + fixed-price opening at its cost -> clause as
  option B at the C-minimal price; never follow a clause priced below that.
- Take a cheaper alternative sheet by sending it back; close on the cheapest valid standing offer;
  walk away only to a better alternative; template e-mails, no LLM in the loop (LLM writer 71.6 vs
  72.9 and not repeatable; LLM verdict made P01/P18 worse).
- RFQ: one message in flight per session, the agent picks the thread (fewest of our messages first).
- Practice suppliers answer identical messages identically -> an offline replay of every recorded
  decision state proves "not worse" before any quota is spent.

## Approach

New package `sellm2/` (new code, new structure, one coherent pipeline instead of layered
subclasses), on branch `amiads_branch`. Nothing outside `sellm2/` is edited except team-process
files that AGENTS.md requires (claim in docs/STATUS.md, entries via scripts/log, runs/ via
scripts/pull-runs). `arena_kit` (official kit) is used as a library. The old `sellm/intel`,
`sellm/claims`, `sellm/negotiator` are **not imported by sellm2's runtime code**; tests import them
read-only as an **oracle** to prove the new code reproduces every value and move the measured agent
used (where a difference is intended it is listed and justified). `sellm.lab` (simulator) is used
read-only for stress tests and the fake arena.

### Layout
```
sellm2/
  __init__.py
  __main__.py      CLI: play | run | final | replay | brief | stress   (python -m sellm2 ...)
  knobs.py         every default in one place, each with its evidence line (no dead knobs)
  agent.py         make_agent(package=None, **knobs) -> Buyer: decide(case, threads, focus=None);
                   fallback = self; any exception -> safe move (hold / closing / walk), logged
  knowledge/       THE DATA LAYER (rewritten)
    source.py      read-only package access: SQL without the 200-row cap, facts index, index series,
                   Sunday-release rows from the ID index (not in SQLite); one RLock; never raises
    supplier.py    SupplierBrief per (sid, parts): identity, standard terms, cost_of_money,
                   cash_pressure, archetype, signals {kind: strength, evidence}, contract, own quotes,
                   price history (12-month low, 'below full cost'), scorecard, forecast, drivers
    signals.py     the 13 signal kinds (same rules/patterns/strengths as calibrated Sat 18:30)
    costs.py       should-cost matched on part AND supplier (case fact > own plant > generic x country),
                   one country table
    facts.py       citable facts with figure + sentence: idx windows (12 m, 6 m, recent fall from the
                   12-month peak, recency check), cost, sc otd/ppm, qn, po, fc, news, doc+ctr, quote,
                   case facts; integers plain; rivals private
    overlay.py     case + opening: contact name, quote-PDF standard terms, opening offer, stated
                   drivers vs index, case `facts`, RFQ rivals' offers
  model/
    case.py        CaseModel: fields/options/fixed/must-haves, cost(), price_for(), structures() with a
                   size guard (coordinate descent above 50k combos), c_open, alternative C
    thread.py      ThreadState: ours/theirs, opening, std0/std, standing (1st sheet), alternatives,
                   asks, holds, left, quoted price per structure, refused fields, pace, fresh
    supplier.py    SupplierModel: full-cost estimate + source (case fact > own plant > breakdown XLSX
                   it sent > prior), cost of money, value() (arena_kit.cost.supplier_value)
  policy/
    structure.py   first-ask package (packages at expected end price, keep cash fields, payment by
                   cash position, fast_pay, longest contract on ties), follow the cheapest quoted
                   structure (0.2 % rule), clause option B
    price.py       target, first ask, step sizing, ceilings (keep_below, rival cap), capped/enough,
                   past_target, clause price floor
    arguments.py   one fact per e-mail, order, topic dedupe, hedge guard, "you asked for data"
    close.py       accept / walk / take_alternative / hold; RFQ leader, rivals, holds
    decide.py      pipeline -> Draft {kind, sid, sheets, arguments, flags, reasons[]}; the reasons
                   are logged per move (explainability for the jury and the pitch)
  write.py         template e-mails (the proven wording, so replies replay identically)
  runner.py        practice/sandbox/final: one loop per case in the agent's order, one POST in flight
                   per session, holds for threads near 45 s silence, per-move deadline 15/40 s, close
                   before the cap with the agent's own close (relationship term, alternative), kit
                   closing_move as last resort, resume on 409/crash, attachments waited <= 20 s, logs
                   runs/logs/*-sellm2-*.log + .jsonl, --label -> runs/labels.json; pull-first
                   (report-only for final, restart via `python -m sellm2`); no live-feed endpoint
  replay.py        offline harness over runs/: every recorded decision state -> sellm2's move vs the
                   recorded move (kind, sheets, body); RFQ order reconstructed by the agent's own
                   thread choice; report IDENTICAL / DIFFERS per case
  tests/           test_s2_*.py (collected by `uv run pytest`)
```

### Build order (each step: tests green, ruff clean, scripts/log, commit, push)
0. **Setup** (02:55): `scripts/sync` on main; claim in docs/STATUS.md on main ("Amiad: sellm2 rewrite
   on amiads_branch, files sellm2/"), commit, sync; `git switch -c amiads_branch`,
   `git push -u origin amiads_branch`; add the branch to STATUS Decisions. Leave the foreign local
   change `sellm/lab/twins.json` untouched (not ours; stash-free: never add it).
1. **knowledge/** + oracle tests: for all 46 suppliers x their parts, new SupplierBrief ==
   old dossier on every field decisions read (cost_of_money, cash_pressure, archetype, signal
   kinds/strengths, own should-cost, floor, 12-month low, contact, standard terms); every citable
   sentence verified by `sellm.lab.claims.ClaimChecker` (0 contradicted, no thousands comma in
   integers); simulated Sunday release (tests/intel_fixture.py pattern): a new letter lands in its
   supplier's brief and drives cash_short; all 21 case files x suppliers + 200 garbage inputs never
   raise; p95 < 100 ms per brief; parallel first calls safe.
2. **model/** + unit tests: CaseModel cost == arena_kit.total_cost on every saved deal; structures
   guard; ThreadState on all saved sessions.
3. **policy/ + write.py + agent.py**: port the measured rules into the new pipeline; clause_offer
   and E2g built in. Tests: every saved state gets a valid move (exact negotiable fields, options,
   must-haves, <= 3 sheets), pure function of the threads, our ask never goes back, final offer
   accepted not pushed, no walk-away while a valid offer stands, relationship stop / past_target,
   contact name, RFQ focus, no LLM/no data still works, a bug becomes a safe move, parallel cases
   decide as alone.
4. **replay.py**: reference = the 74.9 run (jonathans_branch@67001e7 sessions) + P18 E2 session.
   Goal: IDENTICAL on every recorded state of all 10 cases, except the listed intended changes
   (E2g on P05's losing thread; anything from step 7). This is the proof of >= 74.9 offline.
5. **runner.py + __main__.py**: fake-arena tests (pattern of tests/test_runner.py on LocalTable):
   RFQ timeout that replaces the offer ID right at the accept, 422/409 races, slow and broken agent,
   attachment held behind another reply, cap closing with the agent's own close, crash + resume,
   two waves, at most one POST in flight per session, grep: no /events, /screen, leaderboard,
   /results in sellm2/. Then arena-sim plumbing (local, free).
6. **Lab stress** `python -m sellm2 stress` (wraps sellm.lab.stress with sellm2.agent:make_agent):
   PASS = 0 crashes, 0 refused moves, 0 broken must-haves, 0 deals worse than the opening, both
   runner modes; plus dry runs on all 19 practice case files and generated hidden-like cases (case
   `facts`, price per 100, incoterm/tooling negotiable, round limit 4-6, RFQ + stabilise).
7. **Targeted improvements** (each a knob, default decided by measurement; replay names the cases
   it changes, only those are played): see section below.
8. **Sandbox (free)**: D01 x3, D02 x3 through the new runner; must not be below the current agent
   (D01 0.921-0.947, D02 0.567).
9. **Practice**: one full run of the 10 hosted cases (10 sessions), labelled
   `sellm2 amiads_branch@<hash>`; scripts/pull-runs; [run] entry with every score and quota left.
10. **Sunday 08:00 data release**: after Omar's `uv run arena data` (and on this machine too),
    `python -m sellm2 brief --all` + knowledge tests on the real release (new letters/news/memo land
    in the right supplier, new wording gets signal patterns if needed), replay again; no committed
    dossier files to rebuild - the briefs are computed from the package at runtime (cached).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Get the team's latest commits and push ours: pull --rebase, then push. Safe to run any time.
# Usage: scripts/sync
set -uo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  if ! git pull --rebase --autostash --quiet origin "$branch"; then
    echo "sync: pull --rebase stopped (conflict or no network)." >&2
    echo "sync: on a conflict fix the files, 'git add' them, 'git rebase --continue', then run scripts/sync again." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$(git rev-list --count "origin/$branch..HEAD")" = "0" ]; then
    echo "sync: up to date with origin/$branch at $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
    exit 0
  fi
  if git push --quiet origin "$branch"; then
    echo "sync: pushed, origin/$branch is at $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "sync: push rejected (someone pushed first?), retrying ($attempt/3)" >&2
  sleep 2
done
echo "sync: could not push after 3 attempts - check the network and your access to the repo" >&2
exit 1

# Plan: `sellm2` - the buyer agent rewritten from scratch (branch `amiads_branch`, folder `sellm2/`)

## Context

Team sellm's agent grew in 12 hours by layering: kit LLM baseline 61.5 -> negotiator v1.1 53.2 ->
v1.2 + calculator 67.5 -> v1.3 data lock 67.7 -> v1.4 argument bank + signals 72.4 -> past_target +
fast_pay 72.9 (main@7a49c38) -> clause_offer 74.9 (jonathans_branch@67001e7, tag best-jonathans_branch-74.9).
omars_branch adds the hedge guard + recent index fall (E2: P18 0.467 -> 0.520; E2g by replay 73.4,
P05's changed thread never played) and the one-loop-per-case runner (P05 0.820 vs 0.665).
Practice board best per case: 76.3 (several of those bests are lucky or LLM paths that did not repeat).

The code is a stack of subclasses and knobs (Negotiator -> Persistent -> Advised) with dead paths
(CALC_KNOBS, LLM writer, levers=theirs, second_choice, creep/zone/push...), duplicated logic
(structures, CASH_FIELDS, country factors x3, index sentences x2, topic()), fragile spots (dossier()
without the package, memo hacks, hold-before-accept hack, runner warm-up hard-coded to sup:70110,
index windows without a date check) and unused knowledge (9 of 13 dossier signals, supplier cost
breakdowns, the case's own `facts` path never exercised in the arena).

**Amiad's request:** rewrite the agent from the ground up using the learning curve, so it wins the
Live Final (Sun 12:00; team freeze 11:00, best branch merged into main by then). Decided by Amiad:
pull first; overwrite nothing; own branch; everything new in a separate folder; **scope = everything
incl. the data layer (dossier knowledge + argument bank)**; **behaviour = proven + targeted
improvements**; **practice quota up to 40 sessions**.

### What the learning curve fixes as the behaviour to keep (all measured, docs/LOG.md)
- Structure in code: cover the horizon; latest payment only for suppliers relaxed about cash, fastest
  for cash-short ones (fast_pay); longest contract where C does not care; C (incl. the relationship
  term with our full-cost estimate) decides every structure, every alternative sheet and every accept.
- Price path: first ask 6 % below target; step = gap / (rounds left x (1 + measured pace)); horizon 4;
  stay 0.6 % below its price; never lower our own price on a structure; accept final_offer/agreed;
  NEVER ask after final_offer (3 of 5 pushes lost the deal); "too low" text -> close the gap at once.
- Target: own-plant should-cost (capped so its opening keeps the sustainable margin); relationship
  cases at the C-minimal price, past_target down to a 5 % lower estimate; else prior 0.945 / 0.88 of
  the opening (0.96 for list_price_fixed>=2 or margin_floor, 0.84 for wants_volume>=2), capped at its
  12-month low; never above 0.985 x reference.
- One checked fact in every e-mail (an argument-free round gets a hold; a duplicate still helps):
  rival offer > own should-cost (price > 1.02x) > falling cost-driver index > recent fall from the
  12-month peak (not to a material_hedged supplier) > argument bank by case type; one per topic;
  integers without thousands comma; only this part and its cost drivers.
- clause_offer: relationship term + negotiable clause + fixed-price opening at its cost -> clause as
  option B at the C-minimal price; never follow a clause priced below that.
- Take a cheaper alternative sheet by sending it back; close on the cheapest valid standing offer;
  walk away only to a better alternative; template e-mails, no LLM in the loop (LLM writer 71.6 vs
  72.9 and not repeatable; LLM verdict made P01/P18 worse).
- RFQ: one message in flight per session, the agent picks the thread (fewest of our messages first).
- Practice suppliers answer identical messages identically -> an offline replay of every recorded
  decision state proves "not worse" before any quota is spent.

## Approach

New package `sellm2/` (new code, new structure, one coherent pipeline instead of layered
subclasses), on branch `amiads_branch`. Nothing outside `sellm2/` is edited except team-process
files that AGENTS.md requires (claim in docs/STATUS.md, entries via scripts/log, runs/ via
scripts/pull-runs). `arena_kit` (official kit) is used as a library. The old `sellm/intel`,
`sellm/claims`, `sellm/negotiator` are **not imported by sellm2's runtime code**; tests import them
read-only as an **oracle** to prove the new code reproduces every value and move the measured agent
used (where a difference is intended it is listed and justified). `sellm.lab` (simulator) is used
read-only for stress tests and the fake arena.

### Layout
```
sellm2/
  __init__.py
  __main__.py      CLI: play | run | final | replay | brief | stress   (python -m sellm2 ...)
  knobs.py         every default in one place, each with its evidence line (no dead knobs)
  agent.py         make_agent(package=None, **knobs) -> Buyer: decide(case, threads, focus=None);
                   fallback = self; any exception -> safe move (hold / closing / walk), logged
  knowledge/       THE DATA LAYER (rewritten)
    source.py      read-only package access: SQL without the 200-row cap, facts index, index series,
                   Sunday-release rows from the ID index (not in SQLite); one RLock; never raises
    supplier.py    SupplierBrief per (sid, parts): identity, standard terms, cost_of_money,
                   cash_pressure, archetype, signals {kind: strength, evidence}, contract, own quotes,
                   price history (12-month low, 'below full cost'), scorecard, forecast, drivers
    signals.py     the 13 signal kinds (same rules/patterns/strengths as calibrated Sat 18:30)
    costs.py       should-cost matched on part AND supplier (case fact > own plant > generic x country),
                   one country table
    facts.py       citable facts with figure + sentence: idx windows (12 m, 6 m, recent fall from the
                   12-month peak, recency check), cost, sc otd/ppm, qn, po, fc, news, doc+ctr, quote,
                   case facts; integers plain; rivals private
    overlay.py     case + opening: contact name, quote-PDF standard terms, opening offer, stated
                   drivers vs index, case `facts`, RFQ rivals' offers
  model/
    case.py        CaseModel: fields/options/fixed/must-haves, cost(), price_for(), structures() with a
                   size guard (coordinate descent above 50k combos), c_open, alternative C
    thread.py      ThreadState: ours/theirs, opening, std0/std, standing (1st sheet), alternatives,
                   asks, holds, left, quoted price per structure, refused fields, pace, fresh
    supplier.py    SupplierModel: full-cost estimate + source (case fact > own plant > breakdown XLSX
                   it sent > prior), cost of money, value() (arena_kit.cost.supplier_value)
  policy/
    structure.py   first-ask package (packages at expected end price, keep cash fields, payment by
                   cash position, fast_pay, longest contract on ties), follow the cheapest quoted
                   structure (0.2 % rule), clause option B
    price.py       target, first ask, step sizing, ceilings (keep_below, rival cap), capped/enough,
                   past_target, clause price floor
    arguments.py   one fact per e-mail, order, topic dedupe, hedge guard, "you asked for data"
    close.py       accept / walk / take_alternative / hold; RFQ leader, rivals, holds
    decide.py      pipeline -> Draft {kind, sid, sheets, arguments, flags, reasons[]}; the reasons
                   are logged per move (explainability for the jury and the pitch)
  write.py         template e-mails (the proven wording, so replies replay identically)
  runner.py        practice/sandbox/final: one loop per case in the agent's order, one POST in flight
                   per session, holds for threads near 45 s silence, per-move deadline 15/40 s, close
                   before the cap with the agent's own close (relationship term, alternative), kit
                   closing_move as last resort, resume on 409/crash, attachments waited <= 20 s, logs
                   runs/logs/*-sellm2-*.log + .jsonl, --label -> runs/labels.json; pull-first
                   (report-only for final, restart via `python -m sellm2`); no live-feed endpoint
  replay.py        offline harness over runs/: every recorded decision state -> sellm2's move vs the
                   recorded move (kind, sheets, body); RFQ order reconstructed by the agent's own
                   thread choice; report IDENTICAL / DIFFERS per case
  tests/           test_s2_*.py (collected by `uv run pytest`)
```

### Build order (each step: tests green, ruff clean, scripts/log, commit, push)
0. **Setup** (02:55): `scripts/sync` on main; claim in docs/STATUS.md on main ("Amiad: sellm2 rewrite
   on amiads_branch, files sellm2/"), commit, sync; `git switch -c amiads_branch`,
   `git push -u origin amiads_branch`; add the branch to STATUS Decisions. Leave the foreign local
   change `sellm/lab/twins.json` untouched (not ours; stash-free: never add it).

  safety check (no invalid move, no push after final_offer, no deal worse than the opening).

  supplier: floor estimate (should-cost / prior, narrowed by every counter), its ladder (first
  counter, give-back share, rounds until final_offer, from the thread), and **lever prices learned
  from its own alternative sheets** (payment days -> its rate; ppm, lead time, deadband, start date,
  contract length -> EUR per unit). Each move it scores candidate asks (structure x price, up to 3
  sheets) by expected final C over the remaining rounds under that model (lowball -> early
  final_offer; small step -> small give-back), and sends the best. Accept/walk by expected value of
  continuing vs the standing offer (never continue after final_offer).

  supplier (I1 payment by rate, I3 ppm menu, lead time, deadband, start date) - general, not per case.

"""The published cost function: what a term sheet costs the buyer in €, plus term helpers.

C covers the buyer's fixed need over a fixed horizon: need the deal does not cover is bought at
the case's fallback price (plus the fallback risk of the category goal), committed volume is bought
needed or not, and units bought before a new price takes effect cost the current price. In
strategic and bottleneck cases a deal that leaves the supplier below a sustainable margin costs
too - pass your estimate of the supplier (`supplier_value`) to price that. Do the arithmetic here,
not in the language model.
"""

import math
import operator
from datetime import date

# Strategic and bottleneck goals: leaving the supplier below a sustainable margin costs.
RELATIONSHIP_GOALS = {"stabilise", "secure_supply"}
OPS = {
    "<=": operator.le,
    "<": operator.lt,
    ">=": operator.ge,
    ">": operator.gt,
    "==": operator.eq,
    "!=": operator.ne,
}


def closing_terms(case, terms, standard=None):
    """The terms a deal would close on: the term sheet, then the supplier's standard terms (from
    its quote PDF) for anything left out, then the case's fixed terms; gaps from the buyer's plan.
    """
    b = case["buyer"]
    freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    plan = {
        "volume_per_year": b["need_per_year"],
        "contract_months": round(12 * b["horizon_years"]),
        "payment_days": b["reference_payment_days"],
        "lead_time_days": b["need_lead_time_days"],
        # an unknown Incoterm counts as the costliest: a cautious buyer does not assume DAP
        "incoterm": max(freight, key=freight.get),
    }
    t = dict(plan)
    for layer in (standard or {}, case.get("fixed_terms", {}), terms):
        t.update({k: v for k, v in layer.items() if v is not None or k not in plan})
    return t


def horizon_start(case):
    """The horizon starts at the fixed or the earliest possible effective date."""
    fixed = case.get("fixed_terms", {}).get("effective_date")
    options = [o for o in case.get("term_options", {}).get("effective_date", []) if o]
    first = fixed or (min(options) if options else None)
    return date.fromisoformat(first) if first else None


def _years(case, t):
    """Years of the horizon a deal covers; a single order (0 months) counts as one year's lot.
    A commitment beyond the horizon neither costs nor earns."""
    months = t["contract_months"]
    return min(months / 12 if months else 1.0, case["buyer"]["horizon_years"])


def _units_before(case, t, years):
    """Units bought between the horizon start and the date a new price takes effect."""
    start = horizon_start(case)
    if not t.get("effective_date") or start is None:
        return 0.0
    lag = (date.fromisoformat(t["effective_date"]) - start).days / 365
    return t["volume_per_year"] * min(max(lag, 0.0), years)


def supplier_value(case, terms, supplier):
    """What a deal is worth to the supplier per unit, in cash: the price at its standard terms that
    would pay it the same. `supplier` is your estimate of it:
      standard       its standard terms (quote PDF, `docs.standard_terms`)
      interest_rate  what money now is worth to it per year (more to a supplier short of cash)
      usual_rate     its usual cost of money (default: interest_rate); tooling paid up front is
                     worth more to it when cash is dearer than usual
      ppm            the defect rate it really achieves (default: its standard ppm commitment)
      extra          EUR per unit it gains (+) or spends (-) beyond these items, e.g. overtime for
                     a faster delivery or idle capacity a larger volume fills (default 0)
    Contract length and an index clause are security, not cash: they do not count here."""
    b, std = case["buyer"], {**supplier["standard"], **case.get("fixed_terms", {})}
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, std)
    years = _years(case, t)
    sold = t["volume_per_year"] * years
    old = _units_before(case, t, years) / sold  # sold at the current price
    rate = supplier["interest_rate"]
    pay = 1 - rate * (t["payment_days"] - std["payment_days"]) / 360
    cash_now = 1 + (rate - supplier.get("usual_rate", rate)) * years / 2
    freight = b["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    ppm = supplier.get("ppm", std.get("ppm_commitment") or 0)
    return (
        t["unit_price"] * (1 - old) * pay
        + old * (b.get("current_unit_price") or 0.0) * pay
        + freight[t["incoterm"]]
        - freight[std["incoterm"]]  # it carries the freight leg
        + ((t.get("tooling_eur") or 0) - (std.get("tooling_eur") or 0)) / sold * cash_now
        - ppm / 1e6 * ((t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0) - (std.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0))
        + supplier.get("extra", 0.0)
    )


def _soft(gap):
    """Margin points below the sustainable margin, as they cost: none above it, quadratic over
    the first 5 points, linear beyond - no kink."""
    if gap <= 0:
        return 0.0
    return gap * gap / 10 if gap <= 5 else gap - 2.5


def relationship_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None, value=None):
    """Strategic and bottleneck goals only: EUR for every margin point the deal leaves the supplier
    below `sustainable_margin_pct`, per year covered. `supplier["full_cost"]` (EUR per unit) is your
    estimate of its full cost; `value` overrides `supplier_value`. Without an estimate: 0."""
    b = case["buyer"]
    per_point, sustainable = b.get("relationship_eur_per_point"), b.get("sustainable_margin_pct")
    if b.get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not per_point or not sustainable or not supplier:
        return 0.0
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    worth = value if value is not None else supplier_value(case, t, supplier)
    margin = (worth - supplier["full_cost"]) / worth * 100
    return per_point * _soft(sustainable - margin) * _years(case, t)


def cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
    """C by part. `standard`: the supplier's standard terms for anything the term sheet leaves out.
    `supplier`: your estimate of the supplier for the relationship term (`supplier_value`)."""
    b, t = case["buyer"], closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    if t.get("unit_price") is None:
        raise ValueError("no unit_price: a term sheet without a price has no cost")
    years = _years(case, t)
    committed = t["volume_per_year"] * years  # bought, needed or not
    covered = min(t["volume_per_year"], b["need_per_year"]) * years
    pre = _units_before(case, t, years)
    at_new_price = (committed - pre) * t["unit_price"]
    spend = pre * (b.get("current_unit_price") or t["unit_price"]) + at_new_price
    per_defect = b.get("cost_per_defect", 0)
    defect_cost = per_defect - min(t.get("chargeback_eur_per_complaint") or 0, per_defect)
    index = index_risk = 0.0
    if clause := t.get("index_clause"):
        path = b.get("index_paths", {}).get(clause["series"], 0.0)
        moved = max(0.0, abs(path) - clause["deadband_pct"] / 100)
        index = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * moved * math.copysign(1, path)
        index_risk = at_new_price * clause["material_share"] * b.get("index_risk_pct", 0) / 100
    uncovered = (b["need_per_year"] * b["horizon_years"] - covered) * b["fallback_unit_price"]
    need = b["need_lead_time_days"]
    return {
        "price": spend,
        "uncovered_need": uncovered,
        "fallback_risk": uncovered * b.get("fallback_risk_pct", 0) / 100,
        "payment_terms": spend * b["interest_rate"] * (b["reference_payment_days"] - t["payment_days"]) / 360,
        "freight": committed * b["freight_eur_per_unit"][t["incoterm"]],
        "late_delivery": b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0) * max(0, t["lead_time_days"] - need),
        "quality": committed * (t.get("ppm_commitment") or 0) / 1e6 * defect_cost,
        "tooling": t.get("tooling_eur") or 0.0,
        "index_clause": index,
        "index_risk": index_risk,
        "relationship": relationship_cost(case, t, supplier=supplier),
    }


def total_cost(case, terms, standard=None, supplier=None):
    """C in EUR; infinite for terms without a price (e.g. a supplier that quotes none), so such a
    sheet is never the cheapest and never beats an alternative."""
    if closing_terms(case, terms, standard).get("unit_price") is None:
        return math.inf
    return round(sum(cost_breakdown(case, terms, standard, supplier).values()), 2)


def score(c_open, c_deal, c_best):
    if c_deal is None:
        return 0.0
    if c_open - c_best <= 0.01:  # no room to negotiate: matching the best is full marks
        return 1.0 if c_deal <= c_best + 0.01 else 0.0
    return min(1.0, max(0.0, (c_open - c_deal) / (c_open - c_best)))


def must_haves_ok(case, terms, standard=None):
    t = closing_terms(case, terms, standard)
    for m in case["buyer"].get("must_haves", []):
        value = t.get(m["field"])
        if value is None and m["op"] not in ("==", "!="):
            return False
        if not OPS[m["op"]](value, m["value"]):
            return False
    return True


def snap(case, field, value):
    """The allowed value closest to `value` (case `term_options`), else `value` unchanged."""
    options = case.get("term_options", {}).get(field)
    if not options or value in options:
        return value
    if isinstance(value, int | float) and all(isinstance(o, int | float) for o in options):
        return min(options, key=lambda o: (abs(o - value), o))
    return options[0]


def complete_offer(case, terms):
    """A valid term sheet: exactly the negotiable fields, gaps from the buyer's plan, snapped."""
    plan = closing_terms(case, {"unit_price": None})
    freight = case["buyer"]["freight_eur_per_unit"]
    plan["incoterm"] = min(freight, key=freight.get)  # when asking, ask for the cheapest freight
    out = {}
    for field in case["negotiable"]:
        value = terms.get(field, plan.get(field))
        if value is None and case.get("term_options", {}).get(field):
            value = case["term_options"][field][0]
        value = snap(case, field, value)
        out[field] = round(value, 2) if field == "unit_price" and value is not None else value
    return out

def quote_terms(text):
    """Terms per section of a quote or order confirmation PDF: stated, standard, fixed, agreed."""
    out, section = {}, None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        section = next((key for head, key in SECTIONS.items() if line.startswith(head)), section)
        label = next((lab for lab in LABELS if line.startswith(lab + " ")), None)
        if section and label:
            out.setdefault(section, {})[LABELS[label]] = _value(LABELS[label], line[len(label) :].strip())
    return out


def standard_terms(events):
def standard_terms(events):
    """The supplier's standard terms from the latest quote PDF in a thread (empty if none)."""
    for msg in reversed(events):
        for att in msg.get("attachments") or []:
            if att.get("name", "").startswith("quote") and att.get("text"):
                return quote_terms(att["text"]).get("standard", {})
    return {}
